description: This file defines a LocalStorageStore class that provides an interface for managing localStorage entries related to user sessions, channels, and UI state in a Mattermost web application. It includes methods for getting, setting, and removing items, as well as handling specific keys for previous channels, viewed types, emojis, and login notifications.

classes.name: LocalStorageStoreClass
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with localStorage, scoped by application state and user context.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item from localStorage, scoped by current base path.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Sets an item in localStorage, scoped by current base path.

methods.name: getPreviousChannelName
methods.description: Gets the previous channel name for a user and team, or redirects if not found.

methods.name: getPreviousViewedType
methods.description: Gets the previous viewed type for a user and team, defaults to CHANNELS.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Removes an item from localStorage.

methods.name: setPreviousChannelName
methods.description: Stores the previous channel name for a user and team.

methods.name: setPreviousViewedType
methods.description: Stores the previous viewed type for a user and team.

methods.name: getPenultimateViewedType
methods.description: Retrieves the penultimate viewed type for a user and team, defaults to CHANNELS.

methods.name: setPenultimateViewedType
methods.description: Stores the penultimate viewed type for a user and team.

methods.name: getPenultimateChannelName
methods.description: Retrieves the penultimate channel name for a user and team, or redirects if not found.

methods.name: setPenultimateChannelName
methods.description: Stores the penultimate channel name for a user and team.

methods.name: removePreviousChannelName
methods.description: Removes stored previous channel name and moves it to penultimate.

methods.name: removePreviousChannelType
methods.description: Removes stored previous channel type and moves it to penultimate.

methods.name: removePreviousChannel
methods.description: Removes previous channel name and type for a user and team.

methods.name: removePenultimateChannelName
methods.description: Removes the penultimate channel name for a user and team.

methods.name: removePenultimateViewedType
methods.description: Removes the penultimate viewed type for a user and team.

methods.name: getPreviousTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves the previous team ID for a user.

methods.name: setPreviousTeamId
methods.description: Stores the previous team ID for a user.

methods.name: getRecentEmojis
methods.description: Gets the list of recent emojis for a user.

methods.name: getTeamIdJoinedOnLoad
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID that was joined on load.

methods.name: setTeamIdJoinedOnLoad
methods.description: Stores the team ID that was joined on load.

methods.name: setWasLoggedIn
methods.description: Sets a flag indicating if the user was logged in.

methods.name: getWasLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user was logged in.

methods.name: setWasNotifiedOfLogIn
methods.description: Sets a flag to notify user about login.

methods.name: getWasNotifiedOfLogIn
methods.description: Checks if user has been notified about login.
